title: Scouter
metaTitle: Scouter App Motion & Illustration Case Study | Funimation
description: App motion, custom illustration, and character animation for Scouter. Explore the product film, finished artwork, and storyboard in this Funimation case study.
kicker: Featured Case Study · App Motion & Illustration
stake: A football-led product story, brought to life through app screens, custom illustration, and character animation.
challenge: Connect Scouter’s product screens with the energy of football in a short, cohesive visual story.
approach: A vivid green palette, custom characters, kinetic typography, and animated interface sequences connect the app with its illustrated football world.
result: A 27-second product film, supported by finished illustration frames and a storyboard showing the progression from initial sketches to final motion.
deliverables: App product film, custom illustration, character animation, motion graphics, storyboard
focus: Product storytelling, interface animation, football-inspired visual development
sceneDescription: Finished illustration frames and the storyboard behind the motion.
sceneAlts: Scouter finished artwork sheet combining football characters, app screens, and green illustrated scenes
